blocks.title: Staff Sign-In
body: For Badger Supports directors and admins, with your Badger Supports Connect account.
help: Signing in happens on Connect, so this site never sees your Connect password.

Once you are signed in, this page shows only the tools your Connect role includes: reading the answers to the forms your role covers, checking that each one reached Connect, and changing the words on this site with the Edit text button. A super admin can change your role in Connect, under Website Forms.
